mn7:5.33: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
mn7:6.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
mn7:7.2: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuṇeyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo, anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.

mn7:12.1: sa kho so bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnañcepi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, nevassa naṃ hoti antarāyāya.
mn7:12.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vatthaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ acchaṃ udakaṃ āgamma parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ, ukkāmukhaṃ vā panāgamma jātarūpaṃ parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ,
mn7:12.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnañcepi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, nevassa naṃ hoti antarāyāya.

mn7:17.1: ‘so atthi idaṃ, atthi hīnaṃ, atthi paṇītaṃ, atthi imassa saññāgatassa uttariṃ nissaraṇa’nti pajānāti.
mn7:18.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn7:18.3: khīṇā jāti. vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ. nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn7:19.1: tena kho pana samayena sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
mn7:19.2: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn7:19.3: gacchati pana bhavaṃ gotamo bāhukaṃ nadiṃ sināyitunti?
mn7:19.6: lokhyasammatā hi bho gotama bāhukā nadī bahujanassa. puññasammatā hi bho gotama bāhukā nadī bahujanassa. bāhukāya ca pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ pavāhetīti.
mn7:20.1: atha kho bhagavā sundarikabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
mn7:21.1: evaṃ vutte sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn7:21.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. abhikkantaṃ bho gotama.
mn7:21.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya; andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti, evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn7:21.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn7:21.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn7:22.1: alattha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn7:22.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
mn7:22.3: khīṇā jāti. vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn7:22.4: aññataro kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
